notes.title: Been about 2 months, time of the next Big Update!
notes.content:
I sometimes nibble on blue cheese.
Occasionally paired with crackers or a glass of wine, but not always.
In fact who knows, I could be doing it at this very moment. I'll never tell.







Performance fixes. Game should run much smoother.

tags.bug: - Performance fixes. Game should run much smoother.

notes.title: i hear people like eggs
notes.content:
Happy easter. Added 2-3 new side eggs on every map.

Also addressed some player requests ;)
[list]
[*] Additional melee weapon on each map, either as a wall buy, ee reward, or can be found on the ground.
[*] New "wonderfizz" esq machine on all maps but Whiteout.
[*] Game creator will now scream into pillow instead of out loud when he loses at super smash bros so his neighbor's don't get upset. 
[/list]

notes.title: It took me 8 months to realize I misspelled "Medieval"
notes.content:
What can you expect, I read at a 3rd grade level.

[b]New Additions:[/b]
Save & Quit option on the Pause Menu
Steam leaderboards for each map
New "Full Throttle" Power drop

[b]New Guns in weapon roulette: [/b]
[list]
[*] M2 Flamethrower (Available on every map once that map's Easter Egg / Master Achievement is complete)
[*] PPSH (On Outbreak, Resistance, Whiteout & Medieval)
[*] Browning Automatic (On Central, Resistance & Medieval)
[*] Remington Model 11 (On Central, Resistance & Medieval)
[/list]

notes.title: More legitimate patch notes
notes.content:
Added "contracts" to try to make this boring ass game more interesting.

Also every map has an easter egg now.

Probably introduced bugs but I'll fix them in future updates probably maybe.

Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to take a shit.

Also every map has an easter egg now.
